title: Governed in Unity Catalog
sub: Film 2 of 6 of Governance you can use: the platform's side. Each build tags the columns from the project's classes, one policy masks by tag, access goes to groups until a date, and a log says who read what.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side. Plum is direct personal data, a paler plum pseudonymous, plain paper none; a tag is the class's chip on a string, and a mask is a plum band of stars. The platform's pages are drawn as forms; files are paper sheets, copied from the example project. A group is a ring of name cards, with its end date on the clasp.
